'''Rat Gnawing the Grain''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. While trapped in [[Hinderstap]], [[Matrim Cauthon]] saw [[Delarn]] use the form while being attacked by the villagers. This allowed Mat to help save Delarn.{{ref/book|12|28}}
